title: Senior Data Analytics
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Data Engineer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

O profissional será responsável por transformar dados complexos em informações estratégicas. Construir pipelines robustos e escaláveis, garantindo a qualidade e a segurança das informações. E gerar insights que apoiarão a tomada de decisões em várias áreas da empresa, incluindo finanças, clientes e software.


Escopo e responsabilidades

  • Construção de Pipelines (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver e monitorar pipelines escaláveis utilizando Python e ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Suporte ao BI e Analytics: Estruturar visões no Metabase para consultas rápidas e gerenciar a exploração de dados complexos via Looker.
  • Otimização de Performance: Escrever queries SQL avançadas e otimizar o consumo de dados das ferramentas de visualização para reduzir custos e tempo de resposta.
  • Qualidade de Dados: Implementar testes e monitoramento para garantir que as métricas no Looker e Metabase estejam sempre íntegras.



Requisitos Técnicos

  • Python: Experiência em automação, integração de APIs e bibliotecas de manipulação de dados.
  • SQL Avançado: Domínio absoluto de SQL para transformações complexas e otimização de bancos analíticos.
  • Looker: Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de modelos, dimensões, medidas e gerenciamento de projetos dentro do Looker.
  • Metabase: Capacidade de configurar dashboards e perguntas via interface e SQL.
  • Pipelines de Dados: Vivência com orquestradores (Airflow, dbt ou similares).
  • Cloud Data Warehouse: Conhecimento em BigQuery.


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados Sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora

Vaga de Técnico de Sustentação em nossa unidade de negócios de Supply Chain.   • Fortes habilidades de atendimento ao cliente e capacidade de multitarefa

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Delivery Manager para liderar a execução de projetos de implantação de soluções AWS em clientes dos EUA. A posição exige experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de escopo fechado e híbrido, além de forte habilidade de comunicação em inglês (nível C1), para interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos complexos de curta duração (em média 3 meses), incluindo assessments, POCs e MVPs.
  • Conduzir implantações de projetos AWS em clientes dos EUA.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento, motivação e produtividade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar cronogramas, escopo, riscos e entregas.
  • Realizar acompanhamento e controle financeiro dos projetos, garantindo saúde orçamentária e rentabilidade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders e clientes, assegurando qualidade e satisfação nas entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de gestão de projetos (de preferência com certificação PMP).


Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente (nível C1) – imprescindível.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de tecnologia e cloud.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação de soluções AWS é um diferencial relevante.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e coordenação de recursos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos híbridas (ágil e waterfall).
  • Certificação PMP (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade de organização, comunicação e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de tecnologia.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos internacionais

title: Salesforce Consultant / Developer
description:
We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Consultant or Developer (minimum 8-10 years of experience) to join our expanding AMS support and Project Delivery team for a leading US-based client. The role requires strong Salesforce expertise in consulting and/or development, excellent communication skills, and the ability to deliver high-quality support and enhancements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day support, maintenance, and enhancement of the client's Salesforce environment.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications.
  • Design, configure, develop, and implement Salesforce solutions (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, etc.).
  • Manage and maintain integrations with other systems.
  • Collaborate with client teams and internal technical resources.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues in a timely manner.
  • Maintain system documentation and support user training efforts.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Salesforce Consultant or Developer.
  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Sales/Service Cloud Consultant, etc.) highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Flows.
  • Experience with integration tools and APIs.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively in a remote setting.


Extensive expertise in some of the following areas:

  • B2B and e-Commerce solutions
  • Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Marketing Cloud
  • Experience Cloud (Community Cloud)
  • Einstein and AI-driven analytics
  • MuleSoft Integration Suite and Integration Designer Platform (IDP)


Nice to have Qualifications:

  • Experience with ChatGPT 4.0 prompt engineering or similar AI tools, particularly document ingestion use cases, is a significant advantage.

title: Suporte Técnico de Inversor Fotovoltaico
description:
Descrição de Cargo:


Atendimento Técnico


1. Conhecimento dos inversores: É importante ter experiência com inversor, incluindo o entendimento de seus recursos, configurações, parâmetros e modos de operação.


2. Diagnóstico e solução de problemas: Ter habilidades em diagnóstico de falhas e solução de problemas é fundamental para o suporte técnico de inversores. Isso envolve a capacidade de identificar e solucionar problemas comuns, como falhas de comunicação, erros de configuração, sobrecargas, curtos-circuitos, entre outros.


3. Configuração: Em muitos casos, os inversores possuem interfaces de configuração, onde é necessário alterar parâmetros e ajustar as configurações de acordo com as necessidades dos clientes. Ter habilidades em configuração de inversores é valioso nesse contexto.


4. Habilidades de comunicação: Além do conhecimento técnico, é importante ter boas habilidades de comunicação para interagir com os clientes, entender suas necessidades, explicar soluções de problemas e fornecer suporte adequado. Isso inclui a capacidade de se comunicar claramente, ouvir atentamente e ser paciente.


Responsabilidades:


● Dar suporte técnico aos clientes à distância e de forma presencial (se necessário);

● Registrar os atendimentos diariamente;

● Preparar e aplicar treinamento;

● Participar de eventos e feiras do setor de energia atendendo ao público;


Requisitos:


● Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica

● Domínio no Pacote Office, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook;

● Disponibilidade para Viajar pelo Brasil;


Modalidade de trabalho:


● Home Office, de Segunda a Sexta-Feira das 09:00 ás 18:00h

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior/Especialista
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.


A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

title: Analista financeiro
description:
Descrição da Empresa Ninja Group é um hub de soluções dedicado a transformar o mercado mobile por meio de tecnologia, fornecimento e serviços especializados.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Analista Financeiro para atuar remotamente.


Este é um cargo de tempo integral com foco no planejamento financeiro do grupo, que inclui análise de demonstrações financeiras, relatórios de desempenho econômico e apoio no processo de tomada de decisões financeiras. No dia a dia, você realizará auditorias financeiras, acompanhará indicadores econômico-financeiros e apoiará o time com relatórios estratégicos.


Qualificações

  • Planejamento Financeiro: Experiência em planejamentos financeiros e domínio em estratégias para alcançar os objetivos econômicos do grupo.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de analisar dados, identificar tendências e propor soluções baseadas em indicadores financeiros.
  • Demonstrativos Financeiros: Conhecimentos avançados na elaboração e análise de demonstrações financeiras e relatórios econômicos.
  • Finanças e Relatórios Financeiros: Familiaridade com práticas financeiras, controle orçamentário e criação de relatórios precisos para a tomada de decisão.


Será um diferencial ter formação em áreas como administração, economia, contabilidade ou áreas correlatas, além de experiência com ferramentas tecnológicas de análise financeira. Conhecimentos em idiomas estrangeiros também são bem-vindos.


Remuneração a combinar

Home Office e Regime PJ

title: PESSOA DESENVOLVEDORA POWER BUILDER
description:
O que buscamos?

Um profissional que atue bem em equipe e possua boa comunicação.


Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Desenvolvimento de implementações e correções;
  • Colaboração com times técnicos e funcionais para soluções eficientes e inovadoras;
  • Mentoria e orientação para desenvolvedores júnior e plenos, compartilhando conhecimentos e melhores práticas;
  • Revisão de código para garantir a qualidade e conformidade com os padrões, além de colaboração em projetos e desenvolvimento de soluções eficazes.
  • Conduzir reuniões de entendimento de requisitos junto a usuários;
  • Especificação de requisitos funcionais e técnicos;
  • Ter a capacidade de propor arquitetura para soluções sistêmicas;
  • Gerar modelo de dados relacional;
  • Implementar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais;
  • Implantar sistemas;
  • Atender chamados corretivos e evolutivos.
  • Atuar como apoio técnico a outros analistas;
  • Liderar pequenas equipes;
  • Metodologias Agile e Waterfall;
  • Gerenciar pequenos projetos.

Requisitos e qualificações

Tecnologias necessárias (sheet Bodyshop):

  • Linguagens: PL/SQL, PowerBuilder (preferencialmente versão 2012 ou superior) e XML;
  • Banco de Dados: Oracle - 12g ou superior (Core) e SQL Server;
  • Ambientes: MS Visual Studio, TFS - Team Foundation Server e Azure;
  • Ferramentas: PowerDesigner (modelos de dados), SQL Developer, MS Project e InfoMaker;
  • Integração: WebServices (PowerBuilder / VB .NET - publicados no IIS), APIs, Arquivos Texto, XML, XLS, DBLinks, Conexões diretas a Banco de Dados;
  • Ensino Superior em Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas afins.


Horário da Vaga:

  • Das 08:00 as 17:30 de segunda a sexta-feira - com 1 hora e 30 minutos de almoço.
  • Modelo de trabalho: CLT - 100% remoto.


OBS.: Hey! Caso você não preencha todos os requisitos da vaga, te convidamos a se candidatar mesmo assim, ok? Faremos uma análise cuidadosa do seu perfil considerando todas as suas qualificações

description:
Somos a Ōner Travel, uma solução completa do ecossistema BeFly para agentes que desejam ter uma plataforma online de vendas. Temos um time apaixonado por viagens e tecnologia, além da solução inteligente, responsável por unir essas duas paixões em uma experiência única, fácil e eficiente.


O que nos move é certeza de que juntos criamos caminhos além do imaginável.

title: Operations Associate - Fluent in English
description:
Operations Associate | Remote (Brazil) | U.S. Market


At Blue Dot BPO , we support U.S.-based companies in building efficient, scalable, and results-driven operations. We are looking for an Operations Associate who is analytical, highly organized, and has a strong sense of ownership to support and optimize critical operational processes in a dynamic, fully remote environment, working directly with the U.S. market.


This is a strategic position for professionals who want to grow in operations, project management, and business analysis while working closely with leadership and cross-functional teams.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$5,000
  • Full-time Brazil contract
  • 100% remote , working directly with the U.S. market
  • Work schedule: 1 PM to 10 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term contract with growth opportunities
  • International, multicultural, and performance-driven environment


Your Responsibilities

  • Support the analysis and optimization of operational processes across departments
  • Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, and propose improvements (SOPs and best practices)
  • Support and/or manage cross-department projects, ensuring deadlines and deliverables
  • Act as a point of contact between operations, leadership, and stakeholders
  • Create operational reports, data analysis, and performance indicators (KPIs)
  • Support strategic decision-making with data and actionable insights
  • Ensure proper organization of documentation, processes, and internal communication


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Engineering, or related fields
  • Fluent English (daily interaction with U.S.-based teams and stakeholders)
  • Previous experience in operations, business analysis, or project coordination
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas)
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with multiple stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Experience with project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp)
  • Knowledge of Business Intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau)
  • Experience in startups or fast-paced environments


Work directly with the U.S. market and grow your career in an environment that values ownership, structure, and results.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour


We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.


We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.


About the Role


You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:


  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance


This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:


  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)

title: Consultor SAP Basis
description:
Visão geral

Especialista SAP BASIS Sênior, com sólida experiência em ambientes SAP de missão crítica para clientes do setor de Utilities / Energia, atuando em projetos e operações que exigem alta disponibilidade, conformidade regulatória, segurança e performance. Vivência comprovada em empresas de geração, transmissão ou distribuição de energia, com domínio dos processos operacionais e impactos sistêmicos do negócio.


Atuação como PJ por tempo determinado, podendo ser renovado.


Responsabilidades

  • Administrar ambientes SAP ECC e SAP S/4HANA , garantindo estabilidade, performance e disponibilidade.
  • Gerenciar landscapes SAP complexos (DEV, QAS e PRD), incluindo administração de transportes (STMS ).
  • Atuar na gestão de componentes da plataforma SAP, como SAP NetWeaver , SAP Kernel e SAP Notes .
  • Realizar instalação, configuração, administração e tuning de bancos de dados SAP HANA , Oracle , SQL Server e MaxDB .
  • Executar atividades de monitoramento proativo dos ambientes SAP por meio de CCMS , SAP Solution Manager e Focused Run .
  • Gerenciar usuários, perfis e autorizações , em conjunto com as áreas de Segurança da Informação e GRC .
  • Planejar e executar patches , upgrades e aplicação de Enhancement Packages (EHPs) .
  • Atuar no atendimento de incidentes críticos , conduzindo análises de causa raiz (Root Cause Analysis ) e Problem Management .
  • Garantir a operação de ambientes críticos , com foco em alta disponibilidade , continuidade de serviços e mitigação de riscos.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Sólida experiência em SAP BASIS .
  • Conhecimento avançado em administração de ambientes SAP on-premise e/ou híbridos.
  • Experiência com monitoramento, troubleshooting e performance tuning de ambientes SAP.
  • Vivência em ambientes críticos, com exigência de alta disponibilidade e resposta a incidentes.

title: Graphic Designer (Toys and Baby Gear)
description:
About Us:

Move2Play is a rapidly growing kids toy company in the e-commerce space. We were founded with a mission to create unique, interactive toys that get kids moving. We're a small but enthusiastic team that likes to work hard, move quickly, and bring thoughtful, engaging products to families across the country.


As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a talented Graphic Designer to help shape the visual identity of our products from concept to shelf.


Job Description:

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our team. This role focuses on graphic design execution for toys and baby gear products — including packaging, print artwork, character illustration, surface graphics, color studies, and visual concept development.


The ideal candidate has strong illustration skills, a sharp eye for color and composition, and experience creating graphics that resonate with both kids and modern parents. This is not an industrial design or soft goods design role — it is a graphics-first position embedded within product development.


**Portfolio or personal website is required.

**Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.


Salary:

30-40K USD | 5-15% Bonus



Responsibilities:

  • Create original character illustrations and playful graphics for toys and baby products
  • Develop surface artwork for products (prints, patterns, decals, labels, etc.)
  • Conduct color studies and create cohesive color palettes across product lines
  • Prepare production-ready print files and packaging dielines
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, brand designers, engineers, and overseas manufacturers to ensure accurate execution
  • Develop instruction manuals, inserts, and other printed collateral
  • Design engaging retail packaging, including layout, typography, callouts, and compliance elements
  • Contribute to new product concepts with visual mockups and graphic direction
  • Maintain brand consistency across all product graphics
  • Stay up-to-date on design trends in toys, baby gear, illustration, and packaging
  • *Leverage AI platforms to enhance and expand design design tasks


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Illustration, or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in graphic design - experience in toys, baby products, or other consumer products is required.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator and Photoshop required; InDesign strongly preferred)
  • Strong illustration skills (vector and/or hand-drawn style)
  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with packaging dielines
  • Solid understanding of typography, color theory, and composition
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail and organization
  • Experience working with overseas manufacturers is a plus
  • Passion for children’s products and understanding of what appeals to both kids and parents
  • *Experience working with AI platforms to improve design outputs


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience designing retail packaging for Amazon or mass retail
  • Experience with character development and brand mascots
  • Familiarity with basic 3D mockups or rendering tools
  • Understanding of toy safety labeling requirements
  • Experience working with licensed IP


Benefits:

  • Fully remote position
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Creative and collaborative work environment
  • Opportunity to directly shape products sold nationally and internationally


  • If you’re a graphic designer who loves illustration, packaging, and creating playful yet beautiful products for kids and families, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Desenvolvedor full stack (Python/Angular/AWS)
description:
Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior (Python/Angular/AWS)


A Elumini está com uma oportunidade para atuar em um squad interno, alocado em um projeto estratégico para um cliente do setor financeiro.

Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior com forte atuação em arquitetura de soluções em nuvem (AWS) e experiência em projetos de média e alta complexidade.


O que esperamos:


✔ Sólida experiência em definição, evolução e sustentação de arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e seguras na AWS

✔ Domínio de serviços como S3, IAM, EC2, RDS, Lambda e API Gateway

✔ Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Python, atuando na construção de APIs, serviços e integrações cloud-native

✔ Experiência em desenvolvimento frontend com Angular

✔ Vivência com FastAPI ou Flask

✔ Experiência com microsserviços

✔ Integração com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais

✔ Boas práticas de organização de código, testes automatizados e versionamento


Diferencial estratégico:


Perfil com capacidade analítica para avaliar arquiteturas complexas, decompor componentes, identificar riscos e dependências, além de orientar decisões técnicas.

Também buscamos alguém que atue em colaboração com o time, apoiando na definição de padrões, organização das entregas, garantindo alinhamento entre negócio e tecnologia.


Início imediato

Projeto no segmento financeiro

Atuação em squad interno da Elumini


Se você busca protagonismo técnico, ambiente desafiador e espaço para influenciar decisões arquiteturais, essa pode ser a sua próxima oportunidade!


Onde? 100% remoto


Benefícios e Incentivos: Saúde e Bem-estar: Assistências Médica e Odontológica (SulAmérica), Seguro de Vida (Prudential), Previdência Privada (Onze) e acesso ao WellHub para cuidar da mente e do corpo, além de VR Caju.


Desenvolvimento: Coparticipação na assinatura do Alura, ajuda para cursos de inglês, Ciclo de Avaliação de Desempenho com Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), e programas internos de mentoria e capacitação profissional.

title: Executivo de Território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
  • Residir na zona norte do Rio de Janeiro.


Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: BI Analyst / Data Analyst – Power BI (Financial Sector)
description:
BI Analyst / Data Analyst – Power BI (Financial Sector)


Location: Brazil

Work Model: Remote

PLEASE SEND RESUMES ONLY IN ENGLISH AND INDICATE LEVEL OF ENGLISH


We are looking for a bilingual Data Analyst with experience in banking and international corporate environments. Specialized in Business Intelligence, process automation, financial reporting, bank reconciliations, and market data management. Strong hands-on experience with Power BI and automation using Power Automate.

The ideal candidate should have a solid background in banking (CIB), reconciliations, budgeting, market data, and financial control, with career progression toward Business Intelligence and advanced analytics.

  • UNIX
  • Azure

  • Data provider management

Languages

  • Modelo 100% remoto

title: Full Stack Engineer (React.js / RoR)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Full Stack Engineer with 3+ years of experience in React.js, TypeScript, and Ruby on Rails to join the core development team of our U.S. client. You will design, build, and deliver the best financial software on the planet!


Our client is a fintech company that provides commodities managers with task automation and timely insights on their trades, including risk exposure, positions, and profits and losses. With over 5 million trades on its SaaS platform, the company is an award-winning industry leader that counts some of the world's largest financial firms as customers. Our client is growing rapidly and is looking for smart, bold risk-takers to further its product strategy of market disruption and expansion.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and test new features for the clients next-gen trading platform
  • Write efficient, maintainable, and reusable code
  • Utilize AI tooling, such as Cursor and CodeRabbit, to accelerate software development
  • Participate in and support the full continuous testing and delivery pipeline
  • Join the engineering support rotation, assisting the Customer Success team
  • Write and maintain unit, integration, and feature tests
  • Review code and tests written by other team members
  • Identify and eliminate technical debt
  • Accept, act on, and provide feedback in a timely manner
  • Seek and provide timely technical assistance and clarification.
  • Collaborate with and mentor team members
  • Learn new technologies (and help your teammates learn them too)
  • Support the clients growth by contributing to open-source projects and representing the client within the developer community


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 3+ years of experience developing full stack applications with React.js and Ruby on Rails
  • Experience with TypeScript, SQL-compliant databases, Go, Python, or other open-source and commercial technologies, such as Kafka and RabbitMQ
  • Proficient in the use of AI tooling such as Cursor and GitHub CoPilot
  • Experience with high-volume, event-based system architectures and Agile software development practices
  • A self-disciplined, task-oriented approach to development, testing, and code structure
  • Desire to work in an environment that:
  • Embraces diversity
  • Maintains a client-centric approach to building products
  • Strives to maintain a world-class organization
  • Loves technology
  • Gives back to the community
  • Proven ability to stay self-motivated, work hard, own problems from start to finish, and bring order from chaos
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or as part of a broader team.
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, transparent, and fun


Preferred Experience

  • University degree in Computer Science, a related field of study, or equivalent experience
  • Experience in finance and/or energy, commodities, or equity trading
  • Experience with enterprise-grade software and highly secure, multi-tenant SaaS solutions
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with real-time, data-streaming technologies such as Kafka
  • Experience with Ember


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior SRE/Platform Engineer (Python/Go)
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It’s built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on platform and infrastructure development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python or Go
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices
  • Good spoken English


Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python or Go) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python + React)
description:
About The Company

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About The Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Supply Chain & Operations technology team. This is a high-impact role focused on rapid application development for business-critical systems that power clients' global supply chain, logistics, and operational excellence.

You'll work embedded within a dynamic, hybrid team of internal engineers and external collaborators, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, UX designers, and technical leads to deliver full-stack solutions that solve real operational challenges. This role requires someone who goes beyond just writing code; you'll need to understand user needs, contribute to requirements analysis, and bring strong product thinking to ensure we're building the right solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop full-stack web applications using React/TypeScript and JavaScript (frontend) and Python/FastAPI (backend) to address operational challenges in supply chain, logistics, and planning systems.
  • Build and optimize solutions for large-scale relational datasets with MySQL or PostgreSQL, ensuring query performance and data integrity.
  • Deploy and maintain containerized applications on Kubernetes, implementing infrastructure updates, connectivity enhancements, and cloud platform improvements.
  • Integrate with third-party systems, external APIs, workflow platforms, and enterprise services (IAM, authentication, etc.) while upholding security and privacy standards.
  • Apply DevSecOps practices throughout the development lifecycle, focusing on security by design, automated testing, and quality gates.
  • Support and maintain production systems, including triaging and resolving bugs, implementing enhancements, and executing planned infrastructure upgrades.


Required Qualifications

  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Proven capabilities in backend development, focusing on Python with FastAPI in the backend , including RESTful API design and asynchronous programming patterns
  • Advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript for modern frontend development, Single Page Applications (SPA), including state management, performance optimization, and accessible UI design
  • Expertise in Vue.js, PHP/Symfony, and databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL).
  • Disciplined approach to code quality and testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) with experience in Git


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Cód. 58141


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei Dev, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Java Backend + Spring avançado (Spring Boot, Data, Cache, MVC, Security etc.)
  • AWS na prática (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFormation e afins)
  • Arquitetura moderna : microsserviços, mensageria (Kafka/SQS) e containers (Docker)
  • Bancos de dados : relacionais (SQL/Aurora/Redshift/PostgreSQL) e não relacionais (BigQuery/Firestore/MongoDB/ElasticSearch)
  • Engenharia de entrega e qualidade : CI/CD + Git, testes automatizados (unit/integr/API) e integração com bancos (relacional e NoSQL)


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: ServiceNow APM Developer (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a ServiceNow Developer with experience in APM to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services with over 300,000 team members in nearly 50 countries. T


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil .


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


The ServiceNow developer will be part of an established team supporting with the implementation of the ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) module. The developer will be activating and configuring the module as well as working closely alongside functional resources to define the system scope and objectives.


Responsibilities :

  • Formulates and defines system scope and objectives.
  • Responsible for program design, coding, testing, debugging and documentation.
  • Technical knowledge and responsibility of all phases of applications systems analysis and programming.
  • Understands the business or function for which application is designed.
  • Continually learn about new technologies, generate new ideas and improve the use of modern technologies across our application portfolio.
  • Configuring and activating Application Portfolio Management (APM)
  • Developing Configuration Item relationships for Business Capabilities, Information Objects, Business Applications, and Application Services
  • Integrating APM with other ServiceNow modules including ITSM and SAM
  • Utilize strong technical competencies and expertise to identify, analyze and troubleshoot any production issues and maintain procedures that meet business user expectations.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams & development teams to understand and provide automated solutions/fixes.
  • Contribute to the continual improvement of Delivery and Support Services processes as well as the maturing of the different portfolios, capabilities, expertise, and best practices in consideration of the user and stakeholder needs and requirements.
  • Participate in SCRUM events and complete assigned items within the determined Sprint target.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • 5+ years of ServiceNow administration experience in the following areas: Service Catalog, CMDB & Discovery, Service Portal, Workflows, Dashboards, REST APIs
  • Experience working in ServiceNow platform as an Admin & Developer
  • Experience in development of Service Catalogs, implementing ACLs, transform maps, Flows via flow designer, client scripts, CMDB health metrics
  • Configuring Assessments, Demands, Business Capability Maps, Information Objects
  • Knowledge of development languages: XML, HTML, CSS, Java, and Java Script
  • Prior working experience on APM module is desirable
  • Ability to work in global distributed setting without supervision

title: Systems Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Systems Engineer to work for our client. The ideal candidate aligns with the responsibilities and qualifications outlined below.


If you’re a systems expert who thrives in cloud‑driven, enterprise environments and you want a fully remote role with real technical ownership, this opportunity will give you the autonomy, complexity, and impact you’re looking for.


About the Role

Our client is seeking a skilled Systems Engineer with strong experience in virtualization, directory services, cloud environments, and enterprise server administration. In this role, you’ll support and optimize core infrastructure, improve system reliability, modernize environments, and play a critical part in supporting global teams.


This is the perfect position for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and working with a modern Microsoft‑centered stack.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage and optimize VMware environments, including configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting
  • Administer Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, identity management, and group policy
  • Support and maintain Windows Server environments across production and staging platforms
  • Implement and manage Azure cloud services, virtual machines, and hybrid integrations
  • Monitor system performance and ensure high availability of critical infrastructure
  • Lead incident resolution, root cause analysis, and remediation efforts
  • Support infrastructure automation, documentation, and best‑practice improvements
  • Collaborate with global IT teams to implement system upgrades, patches, and enhancements
  • Maintain security standards and ensure compliance across systems and environments


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of Systems Engineering experience
  • Strong hands‑on experience with VMware virtualization
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory administration
  • Experience managing and maintaining Windows Server environments
  • Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure and cloud services
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, firewalls, routing preferred)
  • Experience troubleshooting complex enterprise infrastructure issues
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross‑functionally in a remote environment
  • Ability to manage priorities and self‑direct in a distributed team structure


What Our Client Offers

  • Fully remote role based in Brazil with global team collaboration
  • Opportunity to work with modern virtualization and cloud infrastructure
  • High‑impact systems ownership with strong visibility across IT leadership
  • Professional development, cloud learning resources, and certification support
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and long‑term growth opportunities
  • A collaborative, engineering‑minded culture that values innovation and continuous improvement

title: Consultor ABAP/FIORI/CPI (PJ)
description:
Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atuação em desenvolvimentos ABAP avançados em ambiente SAP S/4HANA (Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, CDS Views).
  • Desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações SAP Fiori (Freestyle e/ou Fiori Elements) , com foco em usabilidade e performance.
  • Construção, manutenção e suporte de integrações via SAP CPI , incluindo:
  • Integrações SAP ↔ SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, Ariba, SuccessFactors).
  • Integrações SAP ↔ sistemas legados e terceiros (REST, SOAP, IDoc, OData).
  • Modelagem de iFlows , mapeamentos gráficos e scripts (Groovy).
  • Atuação em troubleshooting de integrações, monitoramento e tratamento de erros.
  • Apoio técnico a times funcionais e participação em definições de arquitetura.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida como Consultor SAP ABAP Sênior .
  • Forte conhecimento em SAP Fiori , SAPUI5 e consumo/exposição de OData Services .
  • Experiência comprovada com SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) .
  • Conhecimento em:
  • APIs REST/SOAP
  • IDocs, RFC, Web Services
  • Integrações síncronas e assíncronas
  • Vivência em projetos S/4HANA e ambientes híbridos (on-premise + cloud).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SAP BTP .
  • Conhecimento em Clean Core e boas práticas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de integração complexos e landscapes distribuídos.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).


Contratação: PJ.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Executivo(a) de Vendas – Remoto

EAD Marketing & Assessoria


Sobre a Empresa

A EAD Marketing & Assessoria é uma empresa especializada na comercialização de produtos de alto valor no mercado digital, atuando com estratégias estruturadas de vendas e relacionamento com clientes.


Descrição do Cargo

Estamos em busca de um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas para atuação remota, com foco na condução do processo comercial do início ao fechamento.


Este(a) profissional será responsável por gerenciar o relacionamento com leads e clientes, identificar oportunidades de negócio e apresentar soluções personalizadas de acordo com as necessidades de cada perfil.


Principais Responsabilidades
  • Conduzir reuniões comerciais por vídeo chamada;
  • Realizar follow-ups estruturados ao longo do ciclo de vendas;
  • Gerenciar pipeline e registros no CRM;
  • Qualificar oportunidades e conduzir negociações;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho e metas comerciais;
  • Contribuir para o crescimento sustentável da área de vendas.

    • Requisitos
    • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas ou fechamento de contratos;
    • Vivência com metas comerciais e acompanhamento de indicadores;
    • Boa organização para gestão de pipeline e CRM;
    • Comunicação verbal e escrita clara e profissional;
    • Capacidade de conduzir negociações de forma estruturada.

    • Diferenciais
    • Experiência no mercado de marketing digital ou infoprodutos;
    • Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de CRM;
    • Experiência com produtos de maior valor agregado.

    • Modelo de Trabalho
    • Atuação 100% remota
    • Remuneração fixa + variável por desempenho
    • Possibilidade de crescimento interno conforme resultados e evolução profissional

title: Project Manager with warehouse experience - Remote
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least ten years of professional experience in successfully executing and managing complex IT projects;
  • Experience working with Logistic integration Projects - mandatory ;
  • Experience with 3PL Integrations - mandatory ;
  • Strong experience in project management methodologies (classic and agile);
  • Organized, result-oriented work style characterized by a high degree of initiative;
  • PMP certification - plus;
  • Written and oral fluency in English (+B2) - mandatory .


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: remote.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software development experience, a strong background in Node.js, and experience using AI code generation tools to join the engineering team of our U.S. client. Working closely with product stakeholders, you will play an integral role in building an industry-leading product.


The client is focused on greater AI-first development, so a significant part of your role will involve designing and implementing AI-driven features using AI-first development techniques. This includes leveraging prompt engineering to optimize the client's AI models and utilizing cutting-edge tools, such as Cursor and Copilot, to enable smarter development.


As a Sr. Software Engineer, your job is to work between the front-end and product teams to create, publish, and develop clean software. Youll create software that facilitates veterinarian-patient communication and reduces the burden on clinic staff! You must see the big picture of where the client is going and fill in the gaps. Do you actively integrate AI tools and techniques into your daily engineering workflow? Do you support thoughtful discussions and challenge existing ideas? Share what you know, learn what you don't.


Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded and growth-stage, comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new applications and features
  • Build and enhance advanced applications using Node.js
  • Design and implement AI-first features using LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude)
  • Integrate and leverage AI development tools like Cursor and Copilot
  • Provide estimates for features, bug fixes, upgrades, and new projects
  • Participate in clearly and concisely documenting applications and custom-built frameworks
  • Write automated unit and feature tests enabling continuous delivery of your great work
  • Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies (especially AI-related) to maximize development efficiency
  • Support other teammates through good communication and feedback during code reviews
  • See the big picture and support the client's mission of facilitating better pet care


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of engineering experience working on consumer-facing (B2C or B2B), high-volume, commercial software products and services
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js, Express, and TypeScript (bonus)
  • Proven expertise in prompt engineering for various AI models
  • Regular use of AI tools like Copilot, Cursor, or others to streamline development is preferred
  • A curiosity to explore how you can improve your workflow using AI
  • Experience with object-oriented programming patterns
  • Experience with scaling and performance improvement
  • Knowledge of both relational and non-relational database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB)
  • High execution mindset while balancing the risk vs costs vs timeline
  • Proven history of delivering production-ready applications promptly
  • Experience creating and consuming API's (preferably with GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services (server setup a bonus)
  • Team player eager to learn from and mentor others
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience (optimally a technical or engineering degree)
  • Strong experience with AI-first development methodologies


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts
description:
HIRING: 2 AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts

We're Not a Startup. We're a $8M Company That Just Decided to Eat the Software Market.


Contract → Full-Time | Remote | 8 AM – 6 PM EST | Monday to Saturday - Start Immediately

First, Let's Talk About Why Your Current Gig Sucks

You already know this, but let's say it out loud:


1. You sit in meetings about meetings. Three hours of \"alignment sessions\" so six people can

approve a button color. Meanwhile, we ship entire features before lunch.


2. Your PRs rot in review queues for days. You wrote the code Monday. It's Thursday. Dave still hasn't looked at it. Dave is \"swamped.\" Here? PR goes up, gets reviewed same day, ships same day.


3. You're a cog and you know it. You own a slice of a microservice that serves a widget inside a dashboard that nobody uses. Here, you own entire product surfaces end-to-end — UI, API, database, deployment. Your name is on it.


4. The \"innovation\" is a lie. They said \"move fast and break things\" in the job post. What they meant was \"move at the speed of legal review and break nothing, ever, including your spirit.\" We actually move fast. Uncomfortably fast.


5. Your tools are chosen by committee. You're stuck on Jenkins pipelines from 2017 and a Jira board with 14 custom fields. We use Claude Code CLI, Linear, GitHub, Vercel, and that's about it. Clean. Fast. Done.


6. The tech debt is someone else's mess and now it's your problem. You inherited a codebase that looks like it was written by 47 different people across 3 continents over 6 years. Because it was. We're building from scratch with modern architecture and AI-first workflows.


7. You have zero ownership. You don't know the customers. You don't see the revenue. You don't feel the impact. Here, you'll watch real call center operators use what you built and hear them say \"this changes everything.\" That's not marketing copy — that's Tuesday.


8. Your compensation is \"competitive\" (it's not). They gave you a 3% raise and called it generous. We do competitive salary + performance bonuses + profit sharing + PTO. You want to write your own ticket? Prove you're an A-player and the money follows.


9. Nobody cares how fast you are. You could ship 10x what your team does and you'd get the same review score as the person who refactored a README. We measure output: PRs merged, features shipped, products launched. Speed is the currency here.


10. You're building someone else's dream. Some VP's pet project. Some board member's \"strategic initiative.\" Here, you're building products for an industry we've spent a decade mastering — and you get a real stake in the outcome.


Who We Are (And Why You Should Care)


I've spent 10 years building and owning call centers. Not advising them. Not consulting for them. Running them. We did $8 million last year in the call center world. We know every pain point, every inefficiency, every moment where operators think \"there has to be a better way.\"

Now there is. We're pivoting to SaaS — and we're building the software suite that the entire call center industry has been waiting for. AI-powered call routing, real-time analytics, agent management, voice AI integration — the whole stack.


Our position is unfair and we like it that way:

  • We have deep domain expertise (10 years, $8M revenue, real operator relationships)
  • We have cash flow — we're not burning runway praying for product-market fit
  • We're raising capital to pour fuel on the fire, but we don't need it to survive
  • We're using Claude Code CLI to build at 5-10x the speed of traditional teams
  • We're bringing our first product to market right now , with a full suite behind it


Two developers + Claude Code + a founder who knows the industry cold = a team that outproduces companies with 10x the headcount. That's not theory. That's the plan.


The Role: What You'll Actually Do Every Day


You'll use Claude Code CLI as your primary development tool , running parallel sessions across git worktrees while maintaining production-quality standards. This isn't \"use AI sometimes.\" This is AI-first development where you orchestrate multiple coding agents and own the output.


Daily work:

  • Build features end-to-end: UI → API → database → tests → deployment
  • Run 3–8 parallel Claude Code instances across worktrees
  • Write and maintain CLAUDE.md project files and agent configurations
  • Decompose features into agent-executable specifications
  • Review, test, and refine AI-generated code for production readiness
  • Ship 2–4 PRs per day (yes, per day)
  • Record quick Loom demos of shipped features


Tech stack:

  • TypeScript (primary), Python (secondary)
  • Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
  • PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Redis
  • Vapi / LiveKit for voice AI
  • Vercel + Supabase for deployment
  • Claude Code CLI — this is the job


Must-Have Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years professional development experience
  • Deep Claude Code CLI proficiency — you should be able to show me your CLAUDE.md from a real project
  • Strong TypeScript + Python
  • React / Next.js production experience
  • PostgreSQL and data modeling chops
  • Git mastery: rebasing, worktrees, bisect, clean history — not just commit and push
  • Test-driven development habits
  • Excellent written English


Work Setup (No Exceptions):

  • High-end computer — your machine needs to handle multiple Claude Code instances, local dev servers, and Docker without breaking a sweat. If your laptop fans sound like a jet engine opening VS Code, this isn't the gig.
  • High-end internet — stable, fast connection. You're screen-sharing, pushing code, and running cloud deploys all day. Laggy internet = laggy output.
  • Available 8 AM – 6 PM EST, Monday –Saturday — 10-hour days. We work hard. I work 80-hour weeks. I'm asking you for 60. That's the deal.
  • Reliability is everything — show up, communicate, deliver. Every day. No disappearing acts.


Communication is IMPERATIVE:


This cannot be overstated. You need to be a clear, proactive communicator. Daily async standups. Responsive on Slack. Articulate in PRs. If something's blocked, you say so immediately — not two days later. We're a small, fast team. Communication gaps don't just slow us down, they kill momentum.


The Transparency Section

We use time tracking software. Not because we're micromanagers — because we're building trust with accountability. Honest work gets honest pay. Simple.


You work 10-hour days. Monday through Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM EST. This is a high-intensity, high-output role. We're bringing a product to market and building a suite behind it. If you want work-life balance right now, I respect that, but this isn't the role. If you want to build something massive and get rewarded for it, keep reading.


We move at startup speed with real-company cash. That means you get the excitement of building from zero without the anxiety of wondering if payroll clears next month.

What You Get


Competitive salary — real money, not \"equity only\"

Performance bonuses — ship fast, get paid more. Directly tied to output.

Profit sharing — we win, you win. Not a poster on the wall. Real checks.

️ Paid time off — because burned-out developers write burned-out code

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
  • You have advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • You are committed to continuously improving yourself and helping those around you


What We Offer:

  • Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits)
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package
  • Remote work
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!



Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. title: SAP Cloud Architect - SAP Basis
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Sr Golang Developer/ 100% Remote in Brazil
description:
Job Profile: Sr Golang Developer

Job Type: Long-time based contract Job Opportunity

Location: 100% Remote in Brazil


Job Description:


Job Description:

Specific Asks

  • 8+ years of experience with at least the last 2-3 years focused on Golang.
  • Sr developer
  • Ability to pick action items and work proactively.
  • Work independently
  • Excellent communication skills

JD:

  • 8+ Years of Software Development Experience
  • Able to apply functional and object-oriented paradigms.
  • Able to apply the SOLID principles.
  • Able to explain REST principles and design APIs that follow them.
  • Experience with SOA, micro-services, and/or distributed architectures
  • Able to architects systems and teaches others about appropriate software design patterns with eye towards scale and reliability
  • Stays abreast of cross-industry/domain technology solutions and able to advocate for new frameworks and technologies within their scope of influence.
  • Demonstrated ability designing and interacting with complex persisted data models.
  • Demonstrated ability to own a technical roadmap.
  • Able to both identify and improve poor performing code or database queries.
  • You are interested in continually learning and mastering new skills.
  • Able to communicate complex ideas and concepts simply and concisely.
  • You are willing to monitor and own the production services the team is responsible for and capable of leading multiple teams in troubleshooting.
  • Able to diagnose the most challenging production issues and implement the observability to provide this ability.
  • Able to lead efforts across enterprise technical teams to drive complex enterprise issues to root cause - along with a plan and measurable progress for resolution.
  • You are empathic and enjoy learning from and mentoring other engineers.

Nice to Haves

  • Open source software and dependency management
  • Object/Document data storage technologies
  • Caching and in-memory database technologies
  • Asynchronous/Multi-threaded Programming Patterns
  • Message queuing technologies/strategies
